leakage_assessment.assertive_path_scan: quantifiers.formal, conclusion.statement_formal/natural_language, i_plus.definition, visibility.definition/negation_conclusion, falsifier.tier_1/tier_2 contain no development-extension or non-extendibility assertion. Every 'inextendib*' token on those paths qualifies a causal geodesic ('future-inextendible causal geodesic of finite affine length'), which is the WCC singular-end vocabulary, never the maximal development or an extension. All development-extension/C2/C0 tokens outside anti_scope live in exclusionary fields (regularity.must_not_conflate, conclusion.forbidden_strengthenings items 1 and 2, anti_scope.not_this_class, anti_scope.phrases_that_are_not_this_class, class_identity_variants).
leakage_assessment.inflation_notes: conclusion.forbidden_strengthenings explicitly bars black-hole non-emptiness, geodesic completeness, C2/C0 inextendibility and the for-all-data reading; i_plus and visibility are both marked role: conclusion/in_conclusion: true; the schema asserts no theorem (epistemic_status open_problem, promotion rule present, review_status verdict pending). The completeness_definition_status field refuses to assert the unverified future-asymptotic-predictability equivalence.
leakage_assessment.variant_containment: The set-based visibility reading is quarantined as class_identity_variants[0] with is_this_class: false, parent class AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, variant_id SET, plus a falsifier and a class-leakage warning; it is not a second class and not a second predicate. The AF_{I+} symbol is defined once (i_plus.predicate_abbreviation) as the only reading in the schema, closing the previously dangling symbol.

assumption_assessment.notes: D0 is a tagged disjoint union (smooth | (sobolev,s,delta)) with s > 5/2, delta in (1/2,1); the old 'suitable regularity' unboundedness is repaired and the D0 definition string is byte-identical across F1/F2a/F2b. i_plus regularity k >= 3 and the conformal Einstein order are declared as assumptions, never conclusions. Genericity uses the subspace topology on X^r_vac(AF) with Baire non-emptiness; the diffeomorphism-quotient gap, meagerness of excluded families, non-vacuity membership and the predictability equivalence are all listed in unresolved_items. Non-vacuity is a declared well-formedness condition, not a conjunct.
residual_gaps: F-085-02: asymptotic_decay rates are bounded by s ('1 <= k <= s', '0 <= k <= s-1') while the smooth branch r = smooth carries no s; two readers can disagree on whether the smooth branch requires decay for all k or only up to an unbound s. Sibling schemas carry the same strings (so this is a shared ambiguity, not an F1/F2 mismatch).

F-085-03: genericity.ambient_space justifies non-emptiness as 'closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire', but the class also has a Frechet (smooth-with-decay) branch; the conclusion survives (Frechet spaces are Baire, closed subsets of Baire spaces are Baire) but the wording is imprecise. Same string in F2a/F2b.

falsifier_assessment.notes: tier_1 names refutes: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, requires a finite-affine-length future-inextendible geodesic with a tail in J^-(q) for an exhibited q in I+, and correctly requires non-meagerness of the failure set for the general route R1, reserving the single-datum route R2 for instantiated G*. machine_checkable_steps (constraint residuals, AF decay, finite affine parameter, causal relation) and non_machine_checkable_step (non-meagerness / membership) are separated. tier_2 is explicitly labelled refutes_strengthening_only. schema_falsifiers include the two-reader test and the vacuity test. The visibility predicate is the canonical single-q TAIL predicate (D5 and visibility.definition), matching the F0 taxonomy text; the whole-curve strengthening is explicitly excluded.
